initial_fueling.assumption: Fuel loaded at origin, priced using a nearby accuracy-weighted dataset station; not a station visit.

optimization.method: cost-aware DAG itinerary followed by greedy fuel purchasing
optimization.range_basis: route miles plus estimated station access miles

warnings: Station access distances are estimates, not separately routed roads. Verify access before driving.
Fuel prices are an assessment snapshot; availability and current prices are not verified.
City-centroid stops are city-level candidates, not verified station coordinates. Their detour_miles are uncertainty budgets; confirm the actual stop and road access.
